experiments.hypothesis: Local-first progress and resume cues will improve multi-session completion without requiring an account.
experiments.implementationDirection: Add versioned local progress, section mastery, notes export, and explicit resume state before any hosted account system.
acceptance: Content-version changes do not silently preserve invalid mastery
Learners can export and delete their local state
experiments.rerun: Re-score learning-harness and fanout on learner-continuity with fresh evidence and at least 2 reviewers.

experiments.hypothesis: A course shell with concept-aware navigation will reduce orientation cost and abandonment.
experiments.implementationDirection: Compile book and concept graphs into persistent course navigation, search, prerequisites, and next/previous actions.
acceptance: A learner can locate the current concept and prerequisite path
Search reaches lessons, concepts, and sources
Every lesson exposes a deterministic next action
experiments.rerun: Re-score learning-harness and walkinglabs on structure-navigation with fresh evidence and at least 2 reviewers.

experiments.hypothesis: A broader semantic visual grammar will let generated lessons explain more mechanisms without screenshots or arbitrary code.
experiments.implementationDirection: Add declarative timeline, causal graph, state machine, parameter plot, and annotated-code primitives with static fallbacks.
acceptance: Every visual states the relationship it explains
Primitive contracts pass narrow-screen and keyboard tests
experiments.rerun: Re-score learning-harness and lighterra on visual-models with fresh evidence and at least 2 reviewers.
